projects.name: Chicago metro area land (two parcels)
projects.quote: Two parcels in the Chicago metro area to support hyperscale and enterprise colocation for an aggregate of 360 megawatts of IT capacity .

projects.name: Charlotte metro area land
projects.quote: In the Charlotte metro area to support development of up to 600 megawatts of IT capacity.

projects.name: Ostend campus land, Frankfurt
projects.quote: Near Digital Realty’s Ostend campus in Frankfurt, Germany to support up to 14 megawatts of IT capacity.

projects.name: Crete, Greece land
projects.quote: Near Crete, Greece to support up to 5 megawatts of IT capacity.

projects.name: Rönesans Infrastructure joint venture, Türkiye data centers
projects.quote: As previously disclosed, during the quarter, Digital Realty entered into a new joint venture with Rönesans Infrastructure to develop data centers across Türkiye for $33 million.

projects.name: Ankara, Türkiye data center
projects.quote: The joint venture's first investment will be a data center in Ankara, expected to support more than 22 megawatts of IT capacity.

projects.name: Dugny, France campus land (freehold interest)
projects.quote: The freehold interest in the land underlying our campus in Dugny, France for approximately €80 million or $90 million.

projects.name: Teraco additional 16% stake
projects.quote: An additional 16% stake in Teraco for approximately $688 million from certain minority shareholders, principally through the issuance of 3.4 million shares of common stock, increasing Digital Realty’s ownership from 61% to approximately 77%.
